mathematical_contract.parallel: For every cusp-free oriented materialized source span C(t), the emitted carrier is exactly C(t)+d*N_left(t). General polynomial and rational offsets remain analytic algebraic carriers; no chord or fitted curve replaces the authoritative result.
mathematical_contract.cusp_partition: Every exactly isolated stationary source parameter partitions the source before the normal branch is selected, so a retained fragment has one continuous exact normal orientation.
mathematical_contract.ph_specialization: When the homogeneous derivative norm has an exact polynomial square root, the same exact offset is materialized as a rational Bezier curve and then enters the same arrangement.
mathematical_contract.joins: Round joins are exact circular conics, bevel joins are exact affine segments, and miter joins use the exact intersection of adjacent tangent lines only when its exact length satisfies the caller's nonnegative limit; otherwise they fall back to bevel.
mathematical_contract.regularization: Raw offset spans and joins are not published directly. The sole CurveRegion2 unary arrangement splits all exact contacts and overlaps, selects the material-side faces, removes collapsed components, and returns a regularized two-dimensional region.
mathematical_contract.fast_path_rule: Analytic-parallel/line and analytic-parallel/circle solvers are optimizations only. Any undecidable fast-path certificate falls through to the complete general resultant authority instead of becoming a new blocker.
mathematical_contract.policy: STRICT and APPROXIMATE_512 construct the same exact carriers, contacts, split graph, and output geometry. APPROXIMATE_512 may terminate only a final undecidable equality or sign at 512 bits and records Approximate512Consumed when it does so.
mathematical_contract.failure_semantics: Unsupported retained-carrier families, unresolved positive-dimensional correspondences, and exhausted exact proofs remain explicit CurveError or Classification blockers; they are never chordized or silently treated as empty.
